result.title: Towards Cost-Efficient Video Dataset Construction with Large Language Models
result.summary: Research on video classification models has witnessed significant growth recently, accompanied by a significant increase in the demand for datasets to train such models. Existing video dataset curation approaches share a common bottleneck: candidate videos must be downloaded before any relevance judgment is made, which results in storage, time and annotation costs. In this work, we present a filtering step, using Large Language Models (LLMs) to pre-screen videos based on their metadata, before actually downloading these videos, thereby saving on these costs. We evaluate the LLMs against a strict human majority vote derived from four independent annotators and validate the reliability of the annotations through inter-annotator agreement analysis (Gwet's AC1). We compare the LLM pre-filter against two no-LLM baselines, namely two keyword heuristics. Via a Leave-One-Rater-Out (LOO) mechanism and an Add-One-Rater-In (AORI), we evaluate the performance of the LLMs as virtual annotators. Finally, we report cost comparisons relative to existing approaches. To ensure reproducability, we made our implementation available on github.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在下载候选视频之前，用 LLM 依据元数据做预筛，以降低视频分类数据集构建的存储、时间与标注成本；以四位标注者的严格多数投票为参照，将 LLM 预筛与两种关键词启发式基线比较，并通过 LOO 与 AORI 机制评估 LLM 充当虚拟标注者的表现，最后给出成本对比。
AI.relevance_reason: 「先看廉价元数据、再决定是否付出昂贵获取成本」这一决策结构与 LVR 中成本感知的证据获取和提前停止（LOOK/STOP 的收益-成本权衡）可能相关，可供核查；但该工作面向视频数据集策展，不涉及内部推理状态或 latent 表示，联系属于概念层面的远距离启发。
